effect_description_eng:
＜Raid＞ (When this Digimon attacks, you may switch the target of attack to 1 of your opponent's unsuspended Digimon with the highest DP.)
[When Attacking] If a card with [Tyrannomon] in its name or [X Antibody] is in this Digimon's digivolution cards, this Digimon may digivolve into a Digimon card with [Tyrannomon] in its name or [Dinosaur] trait in the hand with the digivolution cost reduced by 1.
inherited_effect_description_eng: ＜Piercing＞ (When this Digimon attacks and deletes an opponent's Digimon and survives the battle, it performs any security checks it normally would.)
xros_req: [Digivolve] Lv.4 w/[Tyrannomon] in name w/o [X Antibody] trait: Cost 0
